name: aphrody
description: Pure-Rust single-MCP-server automation surface for Claude Code. ONE native binary `aphrody-mcp` (~9 MB, sub-millisecond cold-start) exposes 42 tools — 8 ex-google_mcp (coding_style_guide, universal_web_fetch, dns_recon, auth_extract, chrome_autopsy, advanced_recon, native_hooks, start_dashboard) + 2 voice (voice_synthesize, voice_transcribe) + 2 Context7 (context7_resolve_library_id, context7_query_docs) + 3 Microsoft Learn (microsoft_docs_search/fetch/code_sample_search) + 3 reverse-engineering (re_triage/re_strings/re_sections via aphrody-re) + 2 aggregators (docs_auto_search, aphrody_mcp_call) + Gemini web (gemini_chat 3.5 Flash, gemini_image Nano Banana, gemini_deep_research) + screen_capture + Adobe Firefly Services (firefly_generate, firefly_generative_expand, firefly_generative_fill) + headless cloud Photoshop/Lightroom/Sensei (photoshop_manifest, photoshop_rendition, photoshop_document_operations, photoshop_auto_tone, photoshop_auto_straighten, photoshop_edit, photoshop_remove_background, photoshop_create_mask, photoshop_product_crop, photoshop_depth_blur, photoshop_action_json, firefly_to_photoshop) + live in-app Photoshop via UXP bridge (photoshop_live_info, photoshop_live_batchplay, photoshop_live_exec). Zero JS runtime in the binary, zero secondary MCP server. 2 slash commands (/status, /docs). 18 agents, 28 skills. Cross-platform: Linux #1, Windows #2, WASM #3.

interface.shortDescription: One Rust binary, 42 tools: automation, vision, voice, RE triage, docs, Gemini web, Adobe Firefly + cloud & live in-app Photoshop.

Zero JS runtime in the binary, zero secondary MCP server. 18 agents, 28 skills. Cross-platform: Linux #1, Windows #2, WASM #3.
